lineage.note: the n=4096 column is a REPRODUCTION of Stage 3b, not independent confirmation of it; P3 tests it as such

recovery mismatches across all three n (.name: recovery mismatches across all three n (240 numbers)
recovery mismatches across all three n (.why: 3 n x 2 classes x 20 k x {mean, sigma_mean}; a count of disagreements at 1e-12 relative, 0 to 240 by construction

worst |recovered - banked| in units of t.name: worst |recovered - banked| in units of that parameter's own sigma
worst |recovered - banked| in units of t.why: a discrepancy measured in the fit's OWN uncertainty, so a shallow optimum is judged by what it can support. 10 sigma is a stated practical ceiling; Stage 3's absolute 1e-9 bar failed this same fit and 3b's conditioning-aware bar cleared it at 2.45e-07

n=4096 cells disagreeing with Stage 3b o.name: n=4096 cells disagreeing with Stage 3b on z(beta)
n=4096 cells disagreeing with Stage 3b o.why: 15 cells, same data and same protocol, so this is a REPRODUCTION check; 0 to 15 by construction. A failure means the two cells are not running the same measurement

worst-over-n (max-min)/mean of the k* se.name: worst-over-n (max-min)/mean of the k* separation
worst-over-n (max-min)/mean of the k* se.why: a relative spread of a positive quantity; 0 is perfect invariance and 2 the practical ceiling (a spread of twice the mean would mean the separation changes sign somewhere)

n at which the z(beta) swing reaches 3x.name: n at which the z(beta) swing reaches 3x
n at which the z(beta) swing reaches 3x.why: a count over the 3 sizes; 2.5 requires all three. MISSED is a clean negative -- the swing would be an n=4096 peculiarity and the disclosure narrower than 3b implied

minimum over n of the SEALED z(beta) per.name: minimum over n of the SEALED z(beta) percentile
minimum over n of the SEALED z(beta) per.why: a percentile, so [0,1] by construction. Stated so that MET is the UNCOMFORTABLE answer: the published window is favourably placed at every n, not just at 4096

instrument.model: sealed science refitted over a window surface at every n

params.name: n
params.why: THE axis this cell adds. Stage 3b measured the whole surface at n=4096 only, and a disclosure resting on one n is a disclosure about one n

params.name: window_lower_k
params.why: carried from 3b, where it was the edge Stage 3 omitted entirely. This is where the significance lives while the separation does not move

params.name: window_upper_rule
params.why: sealed_1e-3 is the science's own OBSERVABLE-matched rule; shared_11 and shared_16 equalise k and thereby de-equalise the observable. Decades spanned are recorded per cell

params.name: discriminant
params.why: what the paper quotes. k* is carried alongside to show the two diverge, which is 3b's finding and the reason this cell exists

params.name: form
params.why: held from the sealed adjudication; an independent audit ran the full ladder on all 24 (n, class, window) cells and F3 wins every one

params.name: bootstrap_B
params.why: 45 cells x 2 classes x 3 n; 600 keeps Monte-Carlo noise well under the 1/sqrt(2(R-1)) ~ 18% floor the 16-replicate ensemble imposes on any resampled SE, which B cannot improve

params.name: error_model
params.why: the sealed fit's own error model, kept so the reproduced z matches the published one. zbeta filed it as optimistic; that is a known limitation, not one this cell introduces

scope: RECERT_SCOPE Stage 3c. Recovers flows at n=1024 and n=2048, BANKS them, and refits the window surface at every n. Changes no instrument and re-grades nothing.
